title: Retain the first locally observed word span across its closing boundary
first_failed_transition: Native pair scope cannot retain the exact first observed word after its first Space; boundary_floor points to the separator after LEFT. GTK first-pair physical baseline passes.
decision: Retain a bounded scalar range for the first locally observed closed word in the existing WordLineage. Derive it only from the existing UnknownStart observed_suffix_chars and an actual observed closing boundary. Native pair scope may reuse that range only when it exactly covers LEFT and its separator in the unchanged admitted input chain. This is the same locally observed-span basis already used for native first-word Space correction; it does not assert absolute document start or promote UnknownStart. Mirror offset zero alone remains insufficient.

alternatives.design: Remove start/floor checks or infer a known start from activation/empty mirror
alternatives.reason: Would manufacture edit authority for unobserved text and truncated mirrors.

alternatives.design: Add a new client text reader, polling path or separate first-pair corrector
alternatives.reason: The existing native first-word observed suffix already supplies the required bounded local edit range; parallel owners and transports are unnecessary.

alternatives.design: Retain existing observed suffix provenance across its first boundary
alternatives.reason: Reuses the current reducer, callback settlement, input frame, chooser, verifier and output executor.

invalidation: Clear on existing input-gap/focus/reset/owner revocation, backspace crossing the separator, or prefix trimming; never rebase the range from text similarity. Tokens and pair-frame equality bind the scalar range to the current lease.

consequences.candidate_and_rank: No candidate generation, lattice retention, lexical attestation, scoring or DecisionCore changes.
consequences.false_authority: Only an entirely observed LEFT plus the actual separator can extend the existing final-pair scope. Raw or manually reconstructed mirror starts remain ineligible.
consequences.latency_and_resources: Two checked u8 offsets in Option<(u8,u8)> for the existing <=160-scalar tail; preserve the existing <=24-byte WordLineage and <=224-byte callback outcome assertions unchanged. No strings, workers, timers, sleeps, polling or new allocations. Clear the range conservatively at the retained-tail limit. Measure Space behavior rather than claim an unmeasured speedup.
consequences.cache_and_concurrency: Existing token equality and frame identity include WordLineage; derive the range at the same first-boundary settlement that already changes lineage generation. It remains stable while typing RIGHT. Existing epochs/deadlines and late-result cancellation stay authoritative.
consequences.packages_and_learning: No models, package formats, delta reloads or learning rules change. Positive learning still requires existing result confirmation; inverse remains the existing sealed operation.
consequences.compatibility: Managed surrounding/preedit branches and all delivery transports remain unchanged. Preserve existing native UnknownStart single-word correction, Tab, daemon Double Shift and atomic/legacy routes.
consequences.rollback: Revert the source slice and restore the accepted 1.0.80 IME bytes; do not restart global IBus or alter input source names.

native_line_clear_successor: Physical first-pair and fresh inverse pass. A sequential eight-Shift then Ctrl+U fixture exposes six stale mirror characters even though the actual client is empty; pair proof/rank is lost before inverse keys. In the existing unhandled command owner, a plain authenticated physical Ctrl+U for native terminal input may retire only the untrusted local tail and background work. Return false and emit no text operation; never infer a field start. Preserve Ctrl+C, Ctrl+Shift+U and Ctrl+Alt+U native contracts. Observed new letters and their actual Space must reconstruct the same first-word range and use the unchanged verifier/executor.
